scope: Pinned host-source audit only. No whole-pool compiler coverage or extraction grade is asserted. Only the SDK reconstructed baseline has been replayed.
constraints: Keep all eight frozen populations in tenancy, including fragments and templates.
Freeze exact source/option variants before full-pool compiler measurement; no parse-result or compiler-success selection.
Reuse existing clang-calls, clang-ast-defs and preproc active_lines; any reconstructed context remains tier B.
Use compiler-owned definitions and filter both truth and extraction through the same evidenced active lines.
A link-unit companion requires evidenced runtime source assembly; do not infer singleton programs.
No template transform is authorized by this audit.

subjects.assembly: Pinned raw .cl roots in the reconstructed CL3.0/SPIR64 baseline; host variants and appended helper source are documented separately.
subjects.known_context: Existing baseline SDK replay only; not every runtime configuration.

subjects.assembly: One file per runtime program; shared includes resolve through the kernel-directory include path.
subjects.known_context: Project build-time syntax check uses CL1.2, default OpenCL header, image support and source/binary include directories. Runtime uses device-default language version and device/vendor options.
subjects.remaining: Keep build-time and runtime contexts distinct; enumerate device/vendor alternatives before compiler grading.

subjects.assembly: cl2cpp converts each raw file independently into a host ProgramEntry, removing comments/blank lines and normalizing text. These entries have empty embedded build options; variable inputs are call-site flags, device defines and configured extra options.
subjects.known_context: No single repository-wide -cl-std. Source-specific type/matrix constants and device defines come from host call sites.
subjects.remaining: Freeze a source-grounded finite variant manifest and source mapping; do not choose a variant by compiler success.

subjects.assembly: Byte-preserving per-file conversion; actual programs prepend fixed macros and generated KParam source, then one or more requested kernel strings.
subjects.known_context: Device maximum OpenCL C version, dimension type and optional math options combine with caller/JIT options.
subjects.remaining: Evidence fixed preludes, caller options and source groupings. Never infer one program per raw file.

subjects.assembly: tplgen converts host-string templates to .clT; kprintf performs runtime substitutions and directive expansion before one final program string is built.
subjects.known_context: No general runtime language-version flag. Offline precompile CL2.0 is a different context.
subjects.remaining: Raw host-string templates are not standalone compiler units. This audit implements and authorizes no template transform; preserve all files and report uncovered scope.

subjects.assembly: Applications generally load one kernel source string and build it with per-application options.
subjects.known_context: No project-wide -cl-std. Some applications use default options; others define block/workgroup sizes or add relative include roots and image/math alternatives.
subjects.remaining: Resolve each application working directory and host-build macro values before grading.

subjects.assembly: Build rules convert .cl line-by-line to escaped host strings; most programs use one converted string, with an independently evidenced inline/multi-string exception.
subjects.known_context: Precision/device alternatives, operation-specific dimensions and math flags vary by source; no project-wide -cl-std.
subjects.remaining: Enumerate evidenced source-specific alternatives rather than one selected compiler-success context.

subjects.assembly: The .cl population consists of headers used by generated consumer programs and preambles. The binding passes one assembled source string and exact options.
subjects.known_context: Package include path plus caller/platform/environment options; no default -cl-std. Cache-miss builds append a generated constant.
subjects.remaining: Use independently generated consumer contexts and preserve source-location mapping; standalone header compilation is not the runtime program.
